title: SDK curriculum & signal fabric: quarterly initiative rollup
creator: Camila Ortiz
description: Build a repeatable quarterly cadence and lightweight operational model that ties SDK curriculum updates, docs/quickstart rollouts, and experiment signals into a single 'signal fabric' for the Developer Experience OKR. The goal is to reduce time-to-value for new users, create a closed-loop measurement pipeline for curriculum changes, and give PM/Design/Eng a single place to view health, experiments, and rollout readiness for SDKs, docs, and quickstarts. This ticket scopes the initiative-level orchestration, telemetry contract, and the first quarterly rollup report template.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly rollup template defined and stored in Confluence with sections for OKR progress, user funnels, experiment deltas, and next-quarter commitments
Telemetry contract published: event names, schema, retention windows, sample queries for key metrics (activation funnel, time-to-first-success, sample app conversions)
Signal fabric mapping completed linking SDK metrics, docs engagement, quickstart completions, and support tickets to OKR metrics
Three pilot experiments instrumented end-to-end (one per SDK family) with dashboards and statistical significance guardrails
First rollup produced for Q2 and reviewed with DX leadership and two partner product teams
updates: 2026-02-15: Kickoff with Eng, DX Research, and Docs. Agreed signal owners and initial metric list.
2026-02-26: Telemetry contract draft reviewed; ENG team to implement telemetry helpers in SDKs (ENG-1842 dependency).
2026-03-03: Experiment framework selection narrowed to lightweight feature flags + analytics events; backlog created for SDK instrumentation tasks.
2026-03-10: Rollup template v0 added to Confluence (link in links). Requested feedback from two beta customers for signal relevance.
metrics: Activation funnel: signup -> API key -> first successful API call using SDK -> sample app run
Quickstart completion rate within 24 hours and 7 days
Docs-to-code conversions (clicks on code samples -> repo clone/star -> PRs created)
Experiment lift and p-value for primary outcomes per pilot
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Q2): define telemetry contract, instrument pilot SDKs, create rollup template, run 3 pilots. Phase 2 (Q3): extend instrumentation across all SDK families, iterate doc/quickstart changes based on pilot signals, add automation for weekly signal ingestion. Phase 3 (Q4): integrate rollup into leadership ops cadence, enable automatic alerts for regressions, and hand off standard operating procedures to DX ops. Each phase includes a review gate and go/no-go checklist that references the acceptance criteria.
risks: Incomplete instrumentation across SDKs leads to noisy signals and invalid conclusions
Experiment interference: overlapping experiments in docs and SDK repos may confound attribution
Data latency: telemetry ingestion delays can slow the rollup cadence and decision-making
Resource contention: ENG backlog pressure (esp. ENG-1842) could delay pilot instrumentation
notes: This initiative aims to be pragmatic: start with high-signal low-effort telemetry (key events + SDK helper libs) and a lightweight rollup that surfaces action items. Avoid building a large monolithic dashboard as the first deliverable — focus on reproducible metrics, clear ownership, and experiment hygiene. Post-mortem and signal taxonomy should be finalized before expanding to all SDKs.
